points: Frontend Code Arena, blind human votes, Sep 22, 2026: GPT-6 Astra first, Claude Fable 5.1 second, Grok 4.7 tenth.

There is no single best model: one tester across four briefs split the wins between GPT-5.6 Sol and Claude Opus 5. The tooling around a model (rendering the page, a design system, references) matters about as much.
Antigravity's strength is a built-in browser that renders and checks the UI. Reviews of its design output are mixed.

Grok: Grok Build is a terminal coding agent (1.0 on Aug 7, 2026). No official desktop app; community GUIs exist. Grokbot is xAI's general agent app, not a coding tool. grok-plugin-cc runs Grok inside Claude Code for reviews and hand-offs.

Tools by output: Figma Make and Google Stitch for editable mockups; UX Pilot for screens plus UX critique; v0 or Subframe for React; Relume and Uizard for wireframes; Midjourney or Firefly for images only.
A good split: explore visual directions in one of those, then build and stress-test flows, states and copy with Claude.
summary: Rankings, Antigravity, Grok, and which tool fits which output.
title: Models and tools for UI work
